# Triple Company for Industrial Development

Triple Company for Industrial Development is an Egyptian table-olive supplier based in Cairo, Egypt. We are preparing for international export of the approved product range for bulk, wholesale, food-service, retail, and private-label buyer discussions. As a newly established company, we are building our supply model through approved partner arrangements. Product specifications, samples, packaging, documentation, MOQ, pricing, and delivery terms are confirmed according to the product and buyer request. We are actively developing buyer relationships and will confirm the applicable commercial and documentation requirements during quotation.

## Products

- Aggizi Green Olives — Egypt's signature export variety; firm texture, mild brine, bright green. Nile Delta origin.
- Toffahi Green Olives — high flesh-to-pit ratio, slightly sweet. Fayoum & Giza origin.
- Hamed Green Olives — traditional Egyptian variety. North Coast origin.
- Manzanilla Green Olives — Spanish variety grown in Egypt; rounded, versatile.
- Natural Black Olives — naturally ripened, brine-cured. Nile Delta origin.
- Oxidized Black Olives — California-style, uniform jet-black; whole, sliced, or pitted. Food-service and pizza-topping staple.
- Stuffed Green Olives — Manzanilla and Aggizi stuffed with pimiento, almond, garlic, or lemon.
- Marinated Artichoke Hearts — tender hearts marinated in oil with Mediterranean herbs.
- Sliced Jalapeño Peppers — crisp pickled rings, bright medium heat.
- Pepperoncini Peppers — mild, tangy golden-green peppers in brine.

Packaging: glass jars, tin cans, plastic buckets, wooden barrels (brine), and vacuum pouches. Whole, pitted, cracked, sliced, and stuffed formats. Full private-label / OEM service available.

## Quality & Documentation

Quality and documentation information is being prepared. Current product specifications and available documents can be requested by qualified buyers.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2024
- Head office: 5th Settlement, Ouroba Square (ميدان العروبة), Cairo, Egypt
- Partner processing facility: 10th of Ramadan Industrial Zone, Sharqia, Egypt
- Standard MOQ: 1 x 20ft container (~16-18 MT); trial pallets and 1-5 kg samples available
- Primary export ports: FOB Alexandria
- Languages: English, French, Arabic
